subject: PO bucketization & SKU line translation for Greenfield onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenfieldlogistics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial onboarding packet and PO needs

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attaching the completed onboarding form and our SKU export. We need to get this vendor setup across three internal cost buckets (North America ops, NA logistics, and EMEA consolidation) — Greenfield’s finance wants spend tracked separately by those buckets.

Two immediate asks from our side:
- Can Redwood issue provisional PO number(s) so we can start provisioning services while routing the invoice workflow?
- The SKU export has SKU codes that map to your product line differently — we saw several line-item mismatches. Can someone on your side share the mapping rules you use for PO line assignment?

Attachments: onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF), sku_mapping_export.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Finance Lead — Greenfield Logistics
alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com>, procurement@greenfieldlogistics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding packet and PO needs

Alex — thanks for the packet, received both attachments. Quick notes and next steps from Redwood:

1) Provisional PO(s): we can issue provisional PO numbers today to unblock provisioning, but finance requires final spend-cap assignment before we convert to standard POs. For your three buckets we typically either create separate POs per cost center or a parent PO with child line allocations. Which would you prefer?

2) SKU mapping: Marissa (cc’d) owns PO line translation. Marissa — can you review the attached CSV and propose a PO line split (one line per SKU group) and flag any SKUs that need manual mapping? If there are >25 manual lines we will ask for a short mapping call.

3) Spend caps: Monica — we’ll need the spend caps per PO to be populated in our provisional matrix so billing can enforce thresholds. Alex, can you confirm target caps for each bucket?

If helpful I can issue temporary POs (format P-XXXX-T) to get you started; we will replace them with final POs once the spend bands are confirmed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

On Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding packet and PO needs

Thanks both. I reviewed sku_mapping_export.csv — high level:

- ~18 SKUs map cleanly to our standard product codes. I annotated those in column 'rf_product_code' in the attached SKU file.
- 7 SKUs appear ambiguous (different naming conventions across your export). I tagged these as "manual" and propose mapping them to three consolidated line items to reduce line noise on the PO.
- There are 2 entries that look like legacy SKUs (old GL prefixes) — need confirmation from your side before we map.

Recommendations:
- Issue three provisional POs, one per logical spend bucket. Format suggestion: P-202601-GF-NAOPS-T1, P-202601-GF-NALOG-T2, P-202601-GF-EMEA-T3. These are temporary and will be swapped for final PO numbers after spend caps are set.
- For the ambiguous 7 SKUs, I recommend mapping them to consolidated line descriptions ("NA: Freight Ops misc", "NA: Warehouse adj", "EMEA: Consolidation misc") — this keeps invoice line counts lower and simplifies reconciliation.

Attachment: provisional_po_matrix.xlsx (I added the suggested provisional PO numbers and a column for requested spend caps)

If Alex can confirm spend caps and the two legacy SKUs by Monday we can push provisional POs live. If not, we should schedule a 20-minute mapping call.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Specialist — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

On Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 10:03 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding packet and PO needs

Marissa, Karthik — thanks for the analysis and the provisional PO suggestions. Confirmations:

- Confirm spend caps: NA Ops $42,000/mo; NA Logistics $85,000/mo; EMEA Consolidation €30,000/mo (please note currency on EMEA PO).
- Legacy SKUs: confirmed those two are retired; please do not map them — we will remove them from our export.
- We reviewed the consolidated descriptions and are OK with the three consolidated line items for the ambiguous SKUs.

I attached an updated onboarding_form_filled_final.pdf with the three cost buckets filled and a short note in the comments field requesting invoice routing to our AP team after the monthly cap is reached. I also signed the DocuSign (link below) for the standard terms.

Attachments: onboarding_form_filled_final.pdf (PDF)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/confirm/XYZ-123456

Would appreciate provisional POs issued before EOD Tuesday so we can queue provisioning tasks.

Best,
Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenfieldlogistics.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Finalizing provisional POs and spend enforcement

Alex — thanks, all clear. Per your caps I ordered provisional POs and set spend enforcement rules as follows: 

- P-202601-GF-NAOPS-T1 -> CAP $42,000 USD/month (alerts at 75% / auto-hold at 100%)
- P-202601-GF-NALOG-T2 -> CAP $85,000 USD/month (alerts at 80% / auto-hold at 100%)
- P-202601-GF-EMEA-T3 -> CAP €30,000/month (alerts at 75% / auto-hold at 100%)

Final PO numbers are provisional and will be replaced with permanent POs after internal finance sign-off. I uploaded the provisional_po_matrix.xlsx to the shared drive and included the PO numbers in the file. Below are the attachment stubs and next steps: 

Attachments: provisional_po_matrix.xlsx (XLSX), sku_mapping_export_mapped.csv (CSV)
Next steps:
- Marissa: please finalize the SKU mapping file and confirm the three consolidated line descriptions; we will push the mapped file to billing.
- Alex: procurement should expect an invoice routing rule to your AP after any PO hits 100% cap.
- Karthik: will follow up with a short note to close the onboarding ticket once provisioning completes.

Thanks — we have the provisional POs live as of 2026-01-22 16:30 PST.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Finance — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
